name: Mariano "emdel" Graziano
biography: is currently a Ph.D. student in the Software and Systems Security group of Eurecom in Sophia-Antipolis (France). He earned a Master of Science in Computer and Communication Networks from Politecnico di Torino (Italy). Mariano is interested in challenging security researches, ranging from hypervisors to backbone routers. Twitter: @emd3l
